channel.title: TechPulse
channel.description: Engineering platform for embedded systems, microcontrollers, home repair, and programming.

item.title: ESP32 Won't Wake from Deep Sleep: Causes and Fixes
item.description: ESP32 deep sleep not waking, waking instantly or draining the battery? Fix RTC GPIO choice, floating pins, wake sources and real sleep current.

item.title: Driving a DC Motor from an ESP32 with a Low-Side MOSFET
item.description: A practical guide to switching and PWM-controlling a small DC motor from an ESP32 using a logic-level MOSFET, a gate resistor, a pull-down and a flyback diode.

item.title: Fixing Relay Chatter When Switching AC Loads from an ESP32
item.description: ESP32 relay clicking repeatedly, buzzing or rebooting? Fix relay chatter with an RC snubber, a separate 5V coil supply, and a proper opto-isolated module.

item.title: Why Your ESP32 Wi-Fi Keeps Dropping (and How to Fix It Permanently)
item.description: ESP32 Wi-Fi disconnects, reconnects, or drops packets? Fix unstable Wi-Fi with power filtering, antenna placement, code tweaks and a common-ground check.

item.title: Why Your LED Strip Flickers: PWM, Power and Ground Explained
item.description: LED strip flickering at low brightness or on long runs? Fix voltage drop, power injection, level shifting and data-line resistors step by step.

item.title: Turn a 2015 Laptop into a Fast Machine: SSD + RAM Upgrade Guide
item.description: An old laptop with an HDD feels unusable. For €60 you can clone the drive to an SSD, add 8 GB RAM and get 10× faster boot times. Full step-by-step guide.

item.title: PC Won't Boot? The 7-Step No-POST Checklist
item.description: PC powers on but no display? Work through the no-POST checklist: RAM reseat, CMOS clear, minimum config, beep codes, PSU paperclip test and BIOS recovery.

item.title: Stop Your Raspberry Pi from Overheating in a Closed Case
item.description: Raspberry Pi throttling in a sealed enclosure? Learn how to read throttle flags, design passive vents, add a PWM fan curve and keep temperatures below 70°C.

item.title: Router Keeps Rebooting? 6 Causes You Can Fix Today
item.description: Router restarts every few hours? Check the power adapter, heat, firmware, DHCP lease table, IP conflict and the ISP line. Diagnose in 20 minutes.

item.title: I2C Timeouts: When Your ESP32 Freezes in Real Life
item.description: A practical guide linking ESP32 I2C clock stretching to everyday smart home, wearables, and industrial failures. Learn why your sensor data freezes and how to fix it.
